notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880692/24eaeaf38824720d39ab9cf06bb8c4eb34776004.png[/img] CLIMBER
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880692/1624d6c0243252191f45b59940bbce18928d089d.png[/img] FLOATER
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880692/94cddfe01a6cf5f3d1e9f0a76d98294b2e5ee774.png[/img] BREATHER
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880692/350231833bb919bf9ded33ea2d7e1eeb59ffa6a7.png[/img] BOMBER
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880692/1ff68d6ebb6eaf30561bb5c12d92c21ade6f5879.png[/img] BLOCKER
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880692/cdfe78c6ec7c818e54388b186cb326523d709cbe.png[/img] BUILDER
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880692/a9cfb178306a0a554e229e63fc7100ea5aa3429b.png[/img] BASHER
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880692/85a87a68233441039574ca888df2b9fa7ad9696b.png[/img] DOWNER
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880692/7b3385345bbe414b3ff8413366d3cc6192d0b7d8.png[/img] UPPER

The editor now also contains an upload button (up arrow) which will send the current map to the Steam Workshop. Any downloaded maps are copied to the maps folder, when the game initially starts.

Also, the editor now allows collectable icons objects to be placed in the map, one type per each of the miner abilities. Thus, when playing a map which contains such items, it is not possible to purchase any abilities, since they can only be collected. The idea is that this would allow people to design maps which are more like logical puzzles which have to be completed. Although I know no one is going to want to do so ...

PLEASE ?-)

maddma

notes.title: T.N.T.S, FUSE BOMBS & LASERS !-)
notes.notes:
first video is "Infinite Weapons Test Demo" !-)

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880692/1e74e2c9f2a508d30f401b0ed73303dbb4dcaa0b.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25880692/261bb0bd67a09bcb9b70b69776027ef5a48209f3.png[/img][/url]

what was the TNT button, is now a more general WEAPONS button. for choosing from the available weapons carried by your selected miner. thus also now, your first two smileys improve your senses, then each extra one taken gives your miner an extra random weapon !-)

in FUSE BOMB mode, you'll see a fading bomb showing where the bomb will be dropped, if you press the left mouse button. also, fuse bombs can be pushed, so as to be dropped down mine shafts ... but do be sure to get out of the way before the fuse runs out ...

BBBOOOOOOOOMMMM !-)

in LASER mode, you'll see a fading laser spot showing where the laser will be fired from, if you press the left mouse button. have fun blasting away!

maddma
